title.en: Chapter 14 — The Beggar in the Cell

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: هولمز قعد طول الليل على الأرض بيفكر.
sentences.en: Holmes sat all night on the floor thinking.

sentences.ar: الصبح، ضحك فجأة وقال: يالله عالحبس.
sentences.en: In the morning, he laughed suddenly and said: come, to the jail.
The beggar was asleep in the cell.

sentences.ar: هولمز جاب إسفنجة مبلولة ومسح وجهه.
sentences.en: Holmes brought a wet sponge and washed his face.
The twisted lip came away with the water.
And under it appeared the face of the missing husband.
